user.title: Connect to the Energy Mapper add-on
user.description: The add-on is usually found automatically. Enter its address only if it was not, or if it runs outside the Supervisor.

data_description.url: Address of the add-on API, for example http://local-energy-mapper:8099.

hassio_confirm.title: Energy Mapper add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the {addon} add-on?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on. Check that it is started and that the address is right.
error.invalid_response: Something answers at this address, but it is not the Energy Mapper add-on.
error.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: Energy Mapper is already set up.

init.title: Energy Mapper settings
init.description: The fields are pre-filled with what the add-on uses: the Energy dashboard, then the add-on options. Change only what is wrong; a field left as found keeps following the Energy dashboard.

data.grid_invert: Grid sensor is positive when exporting
data.battery_invert: Battery sensor is positive when charging

data_description.grid_entity: Power sensor of the whole-house meter, positive when importing.
data_description.grid_export_entity: Only for meters that report import and export as two sensors.
data_description.battery_entity: Power of the home battery, positive when discharging.
data_description.submeters: Power sensors of measured appliances: their power is subtracted before the analysis.

data_description.switched_loads: Appliances whose state tells when they run. Those of the Energy dashboard are always included; an entry here adds one or changes it. On-states: the states in which it runs (default on; off for a pilot-wire radiator relay).

data_description.step_threshold_w: Smallest power change considered as an appliance switching.
data_description.peak_threshold_w: Peaks above this power are notable (for example the subscribed power). Empty: 80 % of the recent maximum.

data_description.analysis_time: A new time applies after the next analysis.
data_description.half_life_days: Age at which a past use counts half in the signature registry.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on. The settings were not saved.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on: start it, then open the settings again.
